title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: dispute window and decision period by product
content:
## Scope

This card gives the two time limits that frame an invoice dispute under each product of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category.

| Product | Dispute window (calendar days from the invoice date) | Decision period (calendar days from the dispute) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 30 | 30 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 30 | 30 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 30 | 30 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 30 | 30 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 30 | 30 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 45 | 30 |

- **Dispute window**: the calendar days from the invoice date within which the billed party may dispute the invoice.
- **Decision period**: the calendar days from a dispute within which the line decides it.

## Points of judgement

**Q: How long does a billed party on AHL Contract Free Time 30 have to dispute an invoice?**
A: 45 calendar days from the invoice date; under the other five products the window is 30.

**Q: Does the decision period vary by product?**
A: No. The line decides a dispute within 30 calendar days under every product.
